clusters.label: Anisotropy (elastic)
clusters.definition: Directional dependence of a material's elastic response.
clusters.reason: All supplied contexts identify elastic or mechanical anisotropy. Different compositions and pressure conditions qualify the claims; the pressure relation concerns an increase in this same property.

clusters.label: Ionic bonding
clusters.definition: Chemical bonding with ionic character arising from electrostatic attraction between oppositely charged constituents.
clusters.reason: Each mention denotes ionic bonding or ionic bond character. Coexisting covalent or van der Waals interactions do not change that concept. Specific bond species, blocks, sites, compositions and analytical indicators remain attached to their original claims; no member denotes a distinct interfacial bonding mechanism.

clusters.label: Ductile nature
clusters.definition: Mechanical capacity to undergo plastic deformation before fracture.
clusters.reason: All mentions describe the same mechanical ductility property, supported by elastic or mechanical analyses. Material, phase and indicator differences qualify individual claims rather than define different concepts.
